name: 28262 · Charlotte, NC
findings: ZIP 28262 (Charlotte) has 292 nonprofit organizations. 151 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 139 organizations.
Education organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28262 (Charlotte) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
